ar.title: اضف instrumental الى vocal recording من غير ان تدفن الصوت
ar.description: Workflow عملي لتحضير vocal source وaccompaniment brief قبل توليد backing track حول غناء موجود.
body: لديك recording قصير فيه لحن بصوتك: ربما hook على الهاتف، demo لفكرة اغنية، او vocal stem من session تملك حق استخدامه. المشكلة تبدأ عندما تطلب من AI ان يضيف band كاملة حوله. النتيجة قد تبدو اكبر، لكنها قد تغطي الكلمات، تغير الاحساس، او تجعل singer يبدو ضائعا داخل arrangement لا يعرف لماذا وجد.
## ما هي EasyMusic.AI؟

[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/ar/ai-music-generator) منصة AI music creation لتحويل prompts وstyle direction وaudio ideas الى drafts قابلة للمراجعة. في workflow اضافة instrumental حول vocal recording، استخدمها كمساحة للتجربة مع source audio تملك حق رفعه، بينما الحقوق، الموافقة، وقرار النشر تبقى خطوات بشرية منفصلة. اذا كان وصف الarrangement غامضا، يمكن ان يساعد [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/ar/tools/music-style-generator) في تحويل warm guitar support او sparse piano ballad الى brief اوضح. وقبل اي submission مدفوع او operation يستخدم credits، راجع [credits explanation](https://easymusic.ai/ar/credits-explanation) حتى تعرف التكلفة الحالية.
## ابدأ بمصدر تستطيع الحكم عليه

الsource الجيد ليس بالضرورة studio vocal مثاليا، لكنه يجب ان يحمل melody واضحة وphrasing مقصودا. اختر مقطعا فيه singer واحد، room noise قليل، وكلمات او humming تستطيع تمييزها من غير تخمين. اذا كان الصوت مجرد شرح spoken، او فيه عدة اصوات، او يتغير tempo كل bar، فقد يفسر النظام المهمة كفكرة عامة لا كغناء يحتاج accompaniment. اكتب note بسيطا: من سجل الصوت، لماذا تملك حق استخدامه، وما الجزء الذي تريد اختباره.
## ارسم accompaniment map قبل الprompt

حدد range قصيرا له بداية ونهاية موسيقية: phrase كامل، chorus hook، او verse line. لا تختار نصف كلمة ولا ending مقطوع. في map صغير، اكتب role الbacking: support the melody، add pulse for demo، keep the vocal intimate، او make the chorus feel wider. ثم اكتب ما يجب الا يحدث: no busy lead guitar over words، no huge drums، no key change، no choir covering the singer. القيود هنا تحمي الصوت الموجود.
## اكتب style brief صغيرا

اطلب arrangement يمكن سماعه حول vocal، لا فوقه. مثال مفيد: soft acoustic guitar and brushed drums, 82 BPM feel, leave space around every line, warm bass only after the first phrase, no lead vocal, no dramatic build. غير instrument واحدا في كل test: piano بدلا من guitar، light percussion بدلا من drums، او warmer bass بدلا من brighter synth. اذا غيرت genre وtempo وdensity معا، لن تعرف لماذا نجحت نسخة وفشلت اخرى.
## قارن النتيجة كمنتج صوتي

استمع الى source الاصلي، ثم النسخة المصاحبة، ثم نسخة بصوت منخفض. هل بقيت الكلمات مفهومة؟ هل تغيرت timing الvocal بطريقة مزعجة؟ هل الbass يغطي نهاية الجمل؟ هل الending يصل قبل اكتمال phrase؟ لا تحكم من solo playback فقط. ضع track تحت video، pitch deck، او demo context اذا كان هذا هو الاستخدام الحقيقي. احيانا افضل revision ليست more instruments، بل fewer instruments and clearer rhythm.
## افكار قابلة للتطبيق اليوم

- اختبر eight bars فقط قبل تحويل recording كامل.
- اكتب permission note بجانب source file قبل upload.
- اختر lead instrument واحدا، ثم support rhythm واحدا، ولا تبدأ بfull band.
- اطلب space around words اذا كانت lyrics او pronunciation مهمة.
- احتفظ بنفس source range عند مقارنة piano، guitar، وsynth versions.
- احفظ original vocal، generated version، review notes، وfinal choice في folder واحد.

## FAQ
### هل احتاج vocal recording مثاليا؟
لا، لكن تحتاج source واضحا بما يكفي للحكم. melody ثابتة وnoise قليل اهم من microphone غالي.
### هل يبقى صوتي كما هو تماما؟
ليس دائما. بعض workflows تولد audio جديدا حول المصدر وقد تعيد تفسير timing او tone. قارن دائما مع original.
### ماذا افعل اذا غطت الموسيقى الكلمات؟
قلل instruments، اضيق range، او اطلب softer rhythm. غالبا المشكلة في density لا في volume فقط.
### هل استطيع رفع اي اغنية لاجرب؟
لا. استخدم audio تملك حق رفعه ومعالجته، وسجل source وpermission قبل التجربة.
### هل الناتج جاهز تجاريا تلقائيا؟
لا. راجع tool terms، حقوق source audio، متطلبات المنصة، وموافقة العميل قبل النشر.

de.title: Instrumental zu einer Vocal Recording hinzufuegen, ohne die Stimme zu begraben
de.description: Ein praktischer Workflow fuer Source Audio und Accompaniment Brief, bevor du ein Backing um bestehenden Gesang generierst.
body: Du hast eine kurze Aufnahme mit einer Melodie: vielleicht einen Hook vom Handy, eine Demo-Idee oder einen Vocal Stem aus einer Session, den du verwenden darfst. Schwierig wird es, wenn du eine komplette Band darum bauen laesst. Das Ergebnis kann groesser wirken, aber die Worte verdecken, den Charakter drehen oder die Stimme in einem Arrangement verlieren, das keinen klaren Auftrag hatte.
## Was ist EasyMusic.AI?

[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/de/ai-music-generator) ist eine AI Music Creation Platform, mit der du Prompts, Style Direction und Audio Ideas in pruefbare Drafts verwandelst. Bei einem Instrumental-um-Vocal-Workflow nutzt du EasyMusic.AI als Entwurfsraum fuer Source Audio, das du hochladen darfst; Rechte, Freigabe und Release-Entscheidung bleiben separate menschliche Checks. Wenn deine Arrangement-Sprache unscharf ist, kann der [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/de/tools/music-style-generator) aus warm guitar support oder sparse piano ballad einen klareren Brief machen. Vor kostenpflichtigen Operationen oder Credit-Verbrauch pruefst du die aktuelle [credits explanation](https://easymusic.ai/de/credits-explanation).
## Beginne mit einer Quelle, die du beurteilen kannst

Eine gute Source muss keine perfekte Studio-Vocal sein, aber sie braucht eine erkennbare melody und absichtliches phrasing. Waehle einen Abschnitt mit einer Stimme, wenig room noise und Worten oder humming, die man ohne Raten versteht. Wenn die Datei eher gesprochene Erklaerung ist, mehrere Stimmen enthaelt oder jedes Bar das tempo wechselt, bekommt das System oft eine vage Idee statt eines Gesangs, der Begleitung braucht. Notiere: Wer hat aufgenommen, warum darfst du es nutzen, und welchen Ausschnitt testest du?
## Zeichne zuerst eine Accompaniment Map

Waehle eine kurze range mit musikalischem Anfang und Ende: eine ganze phrase, einen chorus hook oder eine verse line. Schneide nicht mitten im Wort und nicht in ein unfertiges Ende. In einer kleinen Map steht die Rolle des Backings: support the melody, add pulse for demo, keep the vocal intimate oder make the chorus feel wider. Danach kommen Grenzen: no busy lead guitar over words, no huge drums, no key change, no choir covering the singer. Diese Grenzen schuetzen die vorhandene Stimme.
## Schreibe einen kleinen Style Brief

Fordere ein Arrangement an, das um die Vocal herum sitzt, nicht darauf. Ein brauchbares Beispiel: soft acoustic guitar and brushed drums, 82 BPM feel, leave space around every line, warm bass only after the first phrase, no lead vocal, no dramatic build. Aendere pro Test nur ein Element: piano statt guitar, light percussion statt drums oder warmer bass statt brighter synth. Wenn du genre, tempo und density gleichzeitig aenderst, lernst du wenig aus dem Vergleich.
## Vergleiche wie bei einem Audio-Produkt

Hoere die originale Source, dann die begleitete Version, dann eine leise Wiedergabe. Bleiben die Worte verstaendlich? Hat sich das vocal timing stoerend verschoben? Deckt der bass Satzenden zu? Kommt das ending zu frueh? Beurteile nicht nur solo. Lege den Track unter das Video, Pitch Deck oder Demo Context, wenn dort der echte Einsatz liegt. Manchmal ist die beste Revision nicht more instruments, sondern fewer instruments and clearer rhythm.
## Ideen fuer heute

- Teste acht bars, bevor du die ganze Aufnahme verwendest.
- Schreibe eine permission note neben die source file.
- Starte mit einem lead instrument und einem support rhythm, nicht mit full band.
- Bitte um space around words, wenn lyrics oder pronunciation wichtig sind.
- Behalte dieselbe source range, wenn du piano, guitar und synth vergleichst.
- Speichere original vocal, generated version, review notes und final choice in einem Ordner.

## FAQ
### Brauche ich eine perfekte Vocal Recording?
Nein, aber die Quelle muss klar genug fuer Entscheidungen sein. Stabile melody und wenig noise sind wichtiger als ein teures Mikrofon.
### Bleibt meine Stimme exakt gleich?
Nicht immer. Manche Workflows erzeugen neues Audio um die Quelle herum und koennen timing oder tone neu interpretieren. Vergleiche immer mit dem Original.
### Was tun, wenn die Begleitung die Worte verdeckt?
Reduziere instruments, verkuerze die range oder verlange softer rhythm. Meist ist density das Problem, nicht nur volume.
### Darf ich jeden Song hochladen?
Nein. Nutze nur Audio, das du hochladen und bearbeiten darfst, und dokumentiere source und permission vor dem Test.
### Ist das Ergebnis automatisch kommerziell bereit?
Nein. Pruefe tool terms, Rechte an der source audio, Plattformanforderungen und Kundenfreigabe vor der Veroeffentlichung.

en.title: Add Instrumental Backing to a Vocal Recording Without Burying the Singer
en.description: A practical workflow for preparing source audio and an accompaniment brief before generating backing music around an existing vocal.
body: You have a short recording with a melody in it: a phone hook, a song idea, or a vocal stem from a session you are allowed to use. The trouble starts when you ask AI to put a whole band around it. The result may sound bigger, but it can also cover the words, change the emotional center, or make the singer feel lost inside an arrangement that never got a clear job.
## What is EasyMusic.AI?

[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/ai-music-generator) is an AI music creation platform for turning prompts, style direction, and audio ideas into drafts you can review. In a workflow that adds instrumental backing around a vocal recording, use EasyMusic.AI as a drafting space for source audio you have permission to upload, while rights review, approvals, and release decisions stay separate human checks. If your arrangement language is vague, the [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/tools/music-style-generator) can turn phrases like warm guitar support or sparse piano ballad into a clearer brief. Before paid operations or credit-spending tasks, review the current [credits explanation](https://easymusic.ai/credits-explanation).
## Start With a Source You Can Judge

A useful source does not have to be a perfect studio vocal, but it should carry a clear melody and intentional phrasing. Choose a section with one singer, limited room noise, and words or humming you can recognize without guessing. If the file is mostly spoken explanation, has several competing voices, or drifts in tempo every bar, the system may treat it as a general idea instead of a vocal that needs accompaniment. Write a short note: who recorded it, why you have permission to use it, and which section you want to test.
## Draw an Accompaniment Map Before the Prompt

Pick a short range with a musical start and end: a complete phrase, a chorus hook, or one verse line. Do not cut halfway through a word or stop before the phrase resolves. In a small map, name the backing role: support the melody, add pulse for demo, keep the vocal intimate, or make the chorus feel wider. Then name what must not happen: no busy lead guitar over words, no huge drums, no key change, no choir covering the singer. These boundaries protect the existing voice.
## Keep the Style Brief Small

Ask for an arrangement that sits around the vocal, not on top of it. A useful prompt might say: soft acoustic guitar and brushed drums, 82 BPM feel, leave space around every line, warm bass only after the first phrase, no lead vocal, no dramatic build. Change one instrument or texture per test: piano instead of guitar, light percussion instead of drums, or warmer bass instead of brighter synth. If you change genre, tempo, and density at once, you will not know why one version worked.
## Compare It Like an Audio Product

Listen to the original source, then the accompanied version, then a low-volume playback. Are the words still understandable? Did the vocal timing shift in a way that feels awkward? Does the bass cover line endings? Does the ending arrive too early? Do not judge from solo playback only. Put the track under the video, pitch deck, or demo context if that is the real use. Sometimes the best revision is not more instruments; it is fewer instruments and clearer rhythm.
## Ideas You Can Reuse Today

- Test eight bars before you process the whole recording.
- Write a permission note next to the source file before upload.
- Start with one lead instrument and one support rhythm, not a full band.
- Ask for space around words when lyrics or pronunciation matter.
- Keep the same source range when comparing piano, guitar, and synth versions.
- Store the original vocal, generated version, review notes, and final choice in one folder.

## FAQ
### Do I need a perfect vocal recording?
No, but you need a source clear enough to judge. A steady melody and low noise matter more than an expensive microphone.
### Will my voice stay exactly the same?
Not always. Some workflows create new audio around the source and may reinterpret timing or tone. Always compare against the original.
### What if the backing covers the words?
Reduce instruments, shorten the range, or ask for a softer rhythm. The problem is usually density, not volume alone.
### Can I upload any song to try this?
No. Use audio you have permission to upload and process, and keep source and permission notes before testing.
### Is the result automatically ready for commercial use?
No. Review tool terms, source-audio rights, platform requirements, and client approval before publishing.

es.title: Anade instrumental a una vocal recording sin enterrar al cantante
es.description: Workflow practico para preparar source audio y accompaniment brief antes de generar backing music alrededor de una voz existente.
body: Tienes una grabacion corta con melodia: un hook del telefono, una idea de cancion o un vocal stem de una session que puedes usar. El problema empieza cuando pides a la IA que ponga una banda completa alrededor. El resultado puede sonar mas grande, pero tambien puede tapar las palabras, cambiar el centro emocional o hacer que la voz se pierda dentro de un arrangement sin trabajo claro.
## Que es EasyMusic.AI?

[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/es/ai-music-generator) es una plataforma de AI music creation para convertir prompts, style direction y audio ideas en drafts que puedes revisar. En un workflow que agrega instrumental alrededor de una vocal recording, usa EasyMusic.AI como espacio de borrador con source audio que tienes permiso de subir, mientras rights review, approvals y release decisions siguen siendo checks humanos separados. Si tu lenguaje de arrangement es vago, el [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/es/tools/music-style-generator) puede convertir warm guitar support o sparse piano ballad en un brief mas claro. Antes de operaciones pagadas o tareas que usan credits, revisa la [credits explanation](https://easymusic.ai/es/credits-explanation) actual.
## Empieza con un source que puedas juzgar

Un source util no necesita ser una vocal de estudio perfecta, pero debe tener melodia clara y phrasing intencional. Elige una seccion con una sola voz, poco room noise y palabras o humming que puedas reconocer sin adivinar. Si el archivo es mas bien spoken explanation, tiene varias voces compitiendo o cambia tempo en cada bar, el sistema puede tratarlo como idea general y no como vocal que necesita accompaniment. Escribe una nota corta: quien lo grabo, por que puedes usarlo y que seccion quieres probar.
## Dibuja un accompaniment map antes del prompt

Elige una range corta con inicio y final musical: una phrase completa, un chorus hook o una verse line. No cortes a media palabra ni pares antes de que la phrase resuelva. En un mapa pequeno, nombra el papel del backing: support the melody, add pulse for demo, keep the vocal intimate o make the chorus feel wider. Luego marca lo que no debe pasar: no busy lead guitar over words, no huge drums, no key change, no choir covering the singer. Esos limites protegen la voz existente.
## Mantén pequeno el style brief

Pide un arrangement que rodee la vocal, no que se suba encima. Un prompt util podria decir: soft acoustic guitar and brushed drums, 82 BPM feel, leave space around every line, warm bass only after the first phrase, no lead vocal, no dramatic build. Cambia un instrumento o textura por test: piano en vez de guitar, light percussion en vez de drums, o warmer bass en vez de brighter synth. Si cambias genre, tempo y density a la vez, no sabras por que funciono una version.
## Compara como producto de audio

Escucha el source original, luego la version acompanada y despues playback a bajo volumen. Siguen claras las palabras? Cambio el vocal timing de forma incomoda? El bass tapa endings de lineas? El ending llega demasiado pronto? No juzgues solo en solo playback. Pon el track debajo del video, pitch deck o demo context si ese es el uso real. A veces la mejor revision no es more instruments, sino fewer instruments and clearer rhythm.
## Ideas reutilizables

- Prueba eight bars antes de procesar toda la grabacion.
- Escribe una permission note junto al source file antes de subirlo.
- Empieza con un lead instrument y un support rhythm, no con full band.
- Pide space around words cuando lyrics o pronunciation importan.
- Mantén la misma source range al comparar piano, guitar y synth versions.
- Guarda original vocal, generated version, review notes y final choice en una carpeta.

## FAQ
### Necesito una vocal recording perfecta?
No, pero necesitas un source lo bastante claro para juzgar. Una melodia estable y poco noise importan mas que un microfono caro.
### Mi voz queda exactamente igual?
No siempre. Algunos workflows crean audio nuevo alrededor del source y pueden reinterpretar timing o tone. Compara siempre con el original.
### Que hago si el backing tapa las palabras?
Reduce instruments, acorta la range o pide softer rhythm. El problema suele ser density, no solo volume.
### Puedo subir cualquier song para probar?
No. Usa audio que tengas permiso de subir y procesar, y conserva source y permission notes antes de probar.
### El resultado queda automaticamente listo para commercial use?
No. Revisa tool terms, source-audio rights, platform requirements y aprobacion del cliente antes de publicar.

it.title: Aggiungi instrumental a una vocal recording senza seppellire la voce
it.description: Workflow pratico per preparare source audio e accompaniment brief prima di generare backing music intorno a una voce esistente.

Il problema nasce quando chiedi all IA di costruire una band intera intorno. Il risultato puo sembrare piu grande, ma puo coprire le parole, cambiare il centro emotivo o far perdere la voce dentro un arrangement senza compito chiaro.
## Che cos e EasyMusic.AI?

[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/it/ai-music-generator) e una piattaforma di AI music creation per trasformare prompts, style direction e audio ideas in drafts da rivedere. In un workflow che aggiunge instrumental intorno a una vocal recording, usa EasyMusic.AI come spazio di bozza per source audio che hai il permesso di caricare, mentre rights review, approvals e release decisions restano controlli umani separati. Se il linguaggio dell arrangement e vago, il [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/it/tools/music-style-generator) puo trasformare warm guitar support o sparse piano ballad in un brief piu chiaro. Prima di operazioni pagate o task che consumano credits, controlla la [credits explanation](https://easymusic.ai/it/credits-explanation) aggiornata.
## Parti da una source che puoi giudicare

Una source utile non deve essere una vocal da studio perfetta, ma deve avere una melody chiara e phrasing intenzionale. Scegli una sezione con una sola voce, poco room noise e parole o humming che riconosci senza indovinare. Se il file e soprattutto spoken explanation, ha voci concorrenti o cambia tempo a ogni bar, il sistema puo trattarlo come idea generale invece che come voce da accompagnare. Scrivi una nota breve: chi l ha registrata, perche puoi usarla e quale sezione vuoi testare.
## Disegna una accompaniment map prima del prompt

Scegli una range breve con inizio e fine musicali: phrase completa, chorus hook o verse line. Non tagliare a meta parola e non fermarti prima che la phrase risolva. In una piccola map, nomina il ruolo del backing: support the melody, add pulse for demo, keep the vocal intimate o make the chorus feel wider. Poi scrivi cosa non deve succedere: no busy lead guitar over words, no huge drums, no key change, no choir covering the singer. Questi limiti proteggono la voce esistente.
## Tieni piccolo lo style brief

Chiedi un arrangement che stia intorno alla vocal, non sopra. Un prompt utile puo dire: soft acoustic guitar and brushed drums, 82 BPM feel, leave space around every line, warm bass only after the first phrase, no lead vocal, no dramatic build. Cambia un instrument o una texture per test: piano invece di guitar, light percussion invece di drums, o warmer bass invece di brighter synth. Se cambi genre, tempo e density insieme, non capirai perche una versione funziona.
## Confronta come un prodotto audio

Ascolta la source originale, poi la versione accompagnata, poi un playback a basso volume. Le parole restano comprensibili? Il vocal timing si e spostato in modo strano? Il bass copre le finali delle frasi? L ending arriva troppo presto? Non giudicare solo in solo playback. Metti il track sotto video, pitch deck o demo context se quello e l uso reale. A volte la migliore revision non e more instruments, ma fewer instruments and clearer rhythm.
## Idee riutilizzabili

- Testa eight bars prima di processare tutta la registrazione.
- Scrivi una permission note accanto al source file prima dell upload.
- Parti con un lead instrument e un support rhythm, non con full band.
- Chiedi space around words quando lyrics o pronunciation contano.
- Mantieni la stessa source range quando confronti piano, guitar e synth versions.
- Conserva original vocal, generated version, review notes e final choice in una cartella.

## FAQ
### Serve una vocal recording perfetta?
No, ma serve una source abbastanza chiara da giudicare. Melody stabile e poco noise contano piu di un microfono costoso.
### La mia voce resta esattamente uguale?
Non sempre. Alcuni workflows creano nuovo audio intorno alla source e possono reinterpretare timing o tone. Confronta sempre con l originale.
### Cosa faccio se il backing copre le parole?
Riduci instruments, accorcia la range o chiedi softer rhythm. Il problema di solito e density, non solo volume.
### Posso caricare qualsiasi song per provare?
No. Usa audio che hai il permesso di caricare e processare, e conserva source e permission notes prima del test.
### Il risultato e automaticamente pronto per commercial use?
No. Rivedi tool terms, source-audio rights, platform requirements e approvazione del cliente prima di pubblicare.

ja.title: Vocal recordingにinstrumentalを足しても声を埋もれさせない方法
ja.description: 既存のvocalの周りにbacking musicを生成する前に、source audioとaccompaniment briefを準備する実用workflow。
body: 短い録音の中にmelodyがあります。Phone hook、song idea、または使う権利のあるsessionのvocal stemかもしれません。そこでAIにwhole bandを足してほしいと頼むと問題が始まります。結果は大きく聞こえるかもしれませんが、wordsを覆い、emotionの中心を変え、clear jobを持たないarrangementの中でsingerを迷子にすることもあります。
## EasyMusic.AIとは？

[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/ja/ai-music-generator)は、prompts、style direction、audio ideasをreviewできるdraftsに変えるAI music creation platformです。Vocal recordingの周りにinstrumental backingを足すworkflowでは、uploadするpermissionがあるsource audioのdrafting spaceとしてEasyMusic.AIを使い、rights review、approvals、release decisionsは別のhuman checksとして残します。Arrangementの言葉が曖昧なら、[Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/ja/tools/music-style-generator)がwarm guitar supportやsparse piano balladをより明確なbriefにする助けになります。Paid operationsやcreditsを使うtaskの前には、現在の[credits explanation](https://easymusic.ai/ja/credits-explanation)を確認します。
## 判断できるsourceから始める

Usefulなsourceはperfect studio vocalである必要はありませんが、clear melodyとintentional phrasingが必要です。Singerが一人で、room noiseが少なく、guessしなくてもwordsやhummingを認識できるsectionを選びます。Fileがほぼspoken explanationだったり、voicesが競合していたり、barごとにtempoが揺れる場合、systemはaccompanimentが必要なvocalではなくgeneral ideaとして扱うかもしれません。誰が録音したか、なぜ使えるか、どのsectionをtestするかを短く書きます。
## Promptの前にaccompaniment mapを作る

Musical startとendがある短いrangeを選びます: complete phrase、chorus hook、またはone verse line。Wordの途中で切ったり、phraseがresolveする前に止めたりしないでください。小さなmapにbacking roleを書きます: support the melody、add pulse for demo、keep the vocal intimate、make the chorus feel wider。次に避けることを書きます: no busy lead guitar over words、no huge drums、no key change、no choir covering the singer。このboundariesがexisting voiceを守ります。
## Style briefは小さく保つ

Vocalの上ではなく周りに座るarrangementを頼みます。使えるpromptはこうです: soft acoustic guitar and brushed drums, 82 BPM feel, leave space around every line, warm bass only after the first phrase, no lead vocal, no dramatic build。Testごとにinstrumentまたはtextureを一つだけ変えます: guitarではなくpiano、drumsではなくlight percussion、brighter synthではなくwarmer bass。Genre、tempo、densityを一度に変えると、なぜ成功したか分からなくなります。
## Audio productとして比較する

Original source、accompanied version、low-volume playbackの順に聞きます。Wordsはまだ分かりますか？ Vocal timingがawkwardに動いていませんか？ Bassがline endingsを覆っていませんか？ Endingが早すぎませんか？ Solo playbackだけで判断しないでください。実際の用途がvideo、pitch deck、demo contextなら、その下にtrackを置いて確認します。Best revisionはmore instrumentsではなく、fewer instruments and clearer rhythmであることもあります。
## 今日使えるideas

- Whole recordingの前にeight barsだけtestします。
- Upload前にsource fileの横へpermission noteを書きます。
- Full bandではなく、one lead instrumentとone support rhythmから始めます。
- Lyricsやpronunciationが重要ならspace around wordsを頼みます。
- Piano、guitar、synth versionsを比べる時は同じsource rangeを保ちます。
- Original vocal、generated version、review notes、final choiceを一つのfolderに保存します。

## FAQ
### Perfectなvocal recordingが必要ですか？
いいえ。ただし判断できるほどclearなsourceは必要です。高価なmicrophoneより、steady melodyとlow noiseが重要です。
### 自分の声は完全に同じままですか？
常にそうとは限りません。Sourceの周りにnew audioを作るworkflowでは、timingやtoneが再解釈される場合があります。必ずoriginalと比較してください。
### Backingがwordsを覆う場合は？
Instrumentsを減らし、rangeを短くし、softer rhythmを頼みます。問題はvolumeだけでなくdensityであることが多いです。
### どんなsongでもuploadして試せますか？
いいえ。Uploadとprocessのpermissionがあるaudioだけを使い、test前にsourceとpermission notesを残します。
### 結果は自動的にcommercial use可能ですか？
いいえ。公開前にtool terms、source-audio rights、platform requirements、client approvalを確認してください。

ko.title: Vocal recording에 instrumental을 더해도 singer가 묻히지 않게 하는 법
ko.description: Existing vocal 주변에 backing music을 생성하기 전 source audio와 accompaniment brief를 준비하는 practical workflow.
body: 짧은 recording 안에 melody가 있습니다. Phone hook, song idea, 또는 사용할 권한이 있는 session의 vocal stem일 수 있습니다. 여기에 AI에게 whole band를 붙여 달라고 하면 문제가 시작됩니다. 결과가 더 커 보일 수는 있지만 words를 덮고, emotional center를 바꾸고, clear job이 없는 arrangement 안에서 singer를 잃어버리게 만들 수도 있습니다.
## EasyMusic.AI란?

[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/ko/ai-music-generator)는 prompts, style direction, audio ideas를 review 가능한 drafts로 바꾸는 AI music creation platform입니다. Vocal recording 주변에 instrumental backing을 더하는 workflow에서는 upload permission이 있는 source audio의 drafting space로 EasyMusic.AI를 사용하고, rights review, approvals, release decisions는 별도 human checks로 남겨둡니다. Arrangement language가 vague하다면 [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/ko/tools/music-style-generator)가 warm guitar support나 sparse piano ballad 같은 표현을 더 분명한 brief로 바꾸는 데 도움을 줄 수 있습니다. Paid operations나 credits를 쓰는 tasks 전에는 현재 [credits explanation](https://easymusic.ai/ko/credits-explanation)을 확인하세요.
## 판단할 수 있는 source로 시작한다

Useful source가 perfect studio vocal일 필요는 없지만 clear melody와 intentional phrasing은 필요합니다. Singer가 한 명이고, room noise가 적고, words나 humming을 추측 없이 알아들을 수 있는 section을 고르세요. File이 대부분 spoken explanation이거나 여러 voices가 경쟁하거나 bar마다 tempo가 흔들리면 system은 accompaniment가 필요한 vocal이 아니라 general idea로 해석할 수 있습니다. 누가 녹음했는지, 왜 사용할 권한이 있는지, 어떤 section을 test할지 짧게 적습니다.
## Prompt 전에 accompaniment map을 그린다

Musical start와 end가 있는 짧은 range를 고르세요: complete phrase, chorus hook, one verse line. Word 중간에서 자르거나 phrase가 resolve하기 전에 멈추지 마세요. 작은 map에 backing role을 적습니다: support the melody, add pulse for demo, keep the vocal intimate, make the chorus feel wider. 그런 다음 금지할 것을 적습니다: no busy lead guitar over words, no huge drums, no key change, no choir covering the singer. 이 boundaries가 existing voice를 보호합니다.
## Style brief를 작게 유지한다

Vocal 위가 아니라 주변에 앉는 arrangement를 요청하세요. 유용한 prompt는 이렇습니다: soft acoustic guitar and brushed drums, 82 BPM feel, leave space around every line, warm bass only after the first phrase, no lead vocal, no dramatic build. Test마다 instrument나 texture 하나만 바꿉니다: guitar 대신 piano, drums 대신 light percussion, brighter synth 대신 warmer bass. Genre, tempo, density를 한꺼번에 바꾸면 어떤 이유로 성공했는지 알 수 없습니다.
## Audio product처럼 비교한다

Original source, accompanied version, low-volume playback 순서로 들어보세요. Words가 여전히 이해되나요? Vocal timing이 awkward하게 바뀌었나요? Bass가 line endings를 덮나요? Ending이 너무 빨리 오나요? Solo playback만으로 판단하지 마세요. 실제 사용처가 video, pitch deck, demo context라면 그 밑에 track을 놓고 확인합니다. Best revision은 more instruments가 아니라 fewer instruments and clearer rhythm일 때가 많습니다.
## 오늘 재사용할 ideas

- Whole recording 전에 eight bars만 test합니다.
- Upload 전에 source file 옆에 permission note를 씁니다.
- Full band가 아니라 one lead instrument와 one support rhythm으로 시작합니다.
- Lyrics나 pronunciation이 중요하면 space around words를 요청합니다.
- Piano, guitar, synth versions를 비교할 때 같은 source range를 유지합니다.
- Original vocal, generated version, review notes, final choice를 한 folder에 둡니다.

## FAQ
### Perfect vocal recording이 필요한가요?
아닙니다. 다만 판단할 수 있을 만큼 clear한 source는 필요합니다. 비싼 microphone보다 steady melody와 low noise가 더 중요합니다.
### 내 voice가 정확히 그대로 남나요?
항상 그렇지는 않습니다. Source 주변에 new audio를 만드는 workflow는 timing이나 tone을 다시 해석할 수 있습니다. 항상 original과 비교하세요.
### Backing이 words를 덮으면요?
Instruments를 줄이고, range를 짧게 하거나, softer rhythm을 요청하세요. 문제는 보통 volume만이 아니라 density입니다.
### 아무 song이나 upload해서 시험할 수 있나요?
아닙니다. Upload와 process 권한이 있는 audio만 사용하고, test 전에 source와 permission notes를 남기세요.
### 결과가 자동으로 commercial use 준비가 되나요?
아닙니다. Publish 전에 tool terms, source-audio rights, platform requirements, client approval을 확인하세요.

pt.title: Adicione instrumental a uma vocal recording sem enterrar o cantor
pt.description: Workflow pratico para preparar source audio e accompaniment brief antes de gerar backing music ao redor de uma voz existente.
body: Voce tem uma gravacao curta com melodia: um hook no telefone, uma ideia de musica ou um vocal stem de uma session que pode usar. O problema comeca quando voce pede a IA para colocar uma banda inteira ao redor. O resultado pode soar maior, mas tambem pode cobrir as palavras, mudar o centro emocional ou deixar o cantor perdido dentro de um arrangement sem tarefa clara.
## O que e EasyMusic.AI?

[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/pt/ai-music-generator) e uma plataforma de AI music creation para transformar prompts, style direction e audio ideas em drafts que voce pode revisar. Em um workflow que adiciona instrumental ao redor de uma vocal recording, use EasyMusic.AI como espaco de draft para source audio que voce tem permissao para subir, enquanto rights review, approvals e release decisions continuam checks humanos separados. Se a linguagem de arrangement esta vaga, o [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/pt/tools/music-style-generator) pode transformar warm guitar support ou sparse piano ballad em um brief mais claro. Antes de operacoes pagas ou tasks que usam credits, consulte a [credits explanation](https://easymusic.ai/pt/credits-explanation) atual.
## Comece com um source que voce consegue julgar

Um source util nao precisa ser uma vocal de estudio perfeita, mas deve ter melody clara e phrasing intencional. Escolha uma secao com uma voz, pouco room noise e palavras ou humming que voce reconhece sem adivinhar. Se o arquivo e mais spoken explanation, tem varias vozes competindo ou muda tempo a cada bar, o sistema pode tratar como ideia geral em vez de uma vocal que precisa de accompaniment. Escreva uma nota curta: quem gravou, por que voce pode usar e qual secao quer testar.
## Desenhe uma accompaniment map antes do prompt

Escolha uma range curta com inicio e fim musicais: phrase completa, chorus hook ou verse line. Nao corte no meio de uma palavra nem pare antes da phrase resolver. Em um mapa pequeno, nomeie o papel do backing: support the melody, add pulse for demo, keep the vocal intimate ou make the chorus feel wider. Depois escreva o que nao deve acontecer: no busy lead guitar over words, no huge drums, no key change, no choir covering the singer. Esses limites protegem a voz existente.
## Mantenha o style brief pequeno

Peca um arrangement que fique ao redor da vocal, nao em cima dela. Um prompt util pode dizer: soft acoustic guitar and brushed drums, 82 BPM feel, leave space around every line, warm bass only after the first phrase, no lead vocal, no dramatic build. Mude um instrument ou texture por teste: piano em vez de guitar, light percussion em vez de drums, ou warmer bass em vez de brighter synth. Se voce muda genre, tempo e density de uma vez, nao sabe por que uma version funcionou.
## Compare como um produto de audio

Escute o source original, depois a versao acompanhada, depois um playback em volume baixo. As palavras ainda sao compreensiveis? O vocal timing mudou de forma estranha? O bass cobre line endings? O ending chega cedo demais? Nao julgue so em solo playback. Coloque o track sob video, pitch deck ou demo context se esse for o uso real. As vezes a melhor revision nao e more instruments, e sim fewer instruments and clearer rhythm.
## Ideias reutilizaveis

- Teste eight bars antes de processar a gravacao inteira.
- Escreva uma permission note junto do source file antes do upload.
- Comece com um lead instrument e um support rhythm, nao com full band.
- Peca space around words quando lyrics ou pronunciation importam.
- Mantenha a mesma source range ao comparar piano, guitar e synth versions.
- Guarde original vocal, generated version, review notes e final choice em uma pasta.

## FAQ
### Preciso de uma vocal recording perfeita?
Nao, mas voce precisa de um source claro o bastante para julgar. Melody estavel e pouco noise importam mais que um microfone caro.
### Minha voz fica exatamente igual?
Nem sempre. Alguns workflows criam novo audio ao redor do source e podem reinterpretar timing ou tone. Compare sempre com o original.
### E se o backing cobrir as palavras?
Reduza instruments, encurte a range ou peca softer rhythm. O problema geralmente e density, nao apenas volume.
### Posso subir qualquer song para testar?
Nao. Use audio que voce tem permissao para subir e processar, e mantenha source e permission notes antes do teste.
### O resultado fica automaticamente pronto para commercial use?
Nao. Revise tool terms, source-audio rights, platform requirements e aprovacao do cliente antes de publicar.

ru.title: Добавьте instrumental к vocal recording, не пряча голос
ru.description: Практический workflow: подготовить source audio и accompaniment brief перед генерацией backing music вокруг существующего вокала.
body: У вас есть короткая запись с мелодией: phone hook, идея песни или vocal stem из session, который вы имеете право использовать. Проблема начинается, когда вы просите AI поставить вокруг целую группу. Результат может звучать крупнее, но он также может закрыть words, изменить emotional center или потерять singer внутри arrangement, у которого не было ясной задачи.
## Что такое EasyMusic.AI?

[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/ru/ai-music-generator) - это AI music creation platform для превращения prompts, style direction и audio ideas в drafts, которые можно review. В workflow добавления instrumental backing вокруг vocal recording используйте EasyMusic.AI как drafting space для source audio, которое вы имеете право upload; rights review, approvals и release decisions остаются отдельными human checks. Если язык arrangement расплывчатый, [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/ru/tools/music-style-generator) поможет превратить warm guitar support или sparse piano ballad в более ясный brief. Перед paid operations или задачами с credits проверьте актуальную [credits explanation](https://easymusic.ai/ru/credits-explanation).
## Начните с source, которое можно оценить

Полезное source не обязано быть идеальной studio vocal, но должно иметь clear melody и intentional phrasing. Выберите section с одним singer, небольшим room noise и words или humming, которые можно распознать без догадок. Если file больше похож на spoken explanation, содержит несколько конкурирующих voices или меняет tempo в каждом bar, system может воспринять его как general idea, а не как vocal, которому нужен accompaniment. Напишите короткую note: кто записал, почему вы можете использовать, и какую section хотите test.
## Нарисуйте accompaniment map до prompt

Выберите короткую range с музыкальным началом и концом: complete phrase, chorus hook или one verse line. Не режьте посреди word и не останавливайтесь до resolution. В небольшой map назовите роль backing: support the melody, add pulse for demo, keep the vocal intimate или make the chorus feel wider. Затем назовите запреты: no busy lead guitar over words, no huge drums, no key change, no choir covering the singer. Эти boundaries защищают existing voice.
## Держите style brief маленьким

Попросите arrangement, который сидит вокруг vocal, а не поверх нее. Полезный prompt: soft acoustic guitar and brushed drums, 82 BPM feel, leave space around every line, warm bass only after the first phrase, no lead vocal, no dramatic build. Меняйте один instrument или texture за test: piano вместо guitar, light percussion вместо drums или warmer bass вместо brighter synth. Если менять genre, tempo и density одновременно, вы не поймете, почему одна version сработала.
## Сравнивайте как audio product

Послушайте original source, затем accompanied version, затем low-volume playback. Words все еще понятны? Vocal timing сдвинулся awkward? Bass закрывает line endings? Ending приходит слишком рано? Не судите только по solo playback. Положите track под video, pitch deck или demo context, если это реальное применение. Иногда лучшая revision - не more instruments, а fewer instruments and clearer rhythm.
## Идеи для повторного использования

- Проверьте eight bars до обработки всей записи.
- Напишите permission note рядом с source file до upload.
- Начните с одного lead instrument и одного support rhythm, не с full band.
- Просите space around words, если важны lyrics или pronunciation.
- Сохраняйте одну source range при сравнении piano, guitar и synth versions.
- Держите original vocal, generated version, review notes и final choice в одной папке.

## FAQ
### Нужна ли идеальная vocal recording?
Нет, но source должно быть достаточно clear для оценки. Steady melody и low noise важнее дорогого microphone.
### Мой голос останется точно таким же?
Не всегда. Некоторые workflows создают new audio вокруг source и могут переосмыслить timing или tone. Всегда сравнивайте с original.
### Что делать, если backing закрывает words?
Уменьшите instruments, сократите range или попросите softer rhythm. Обычно проблема в density, а не только в volume.
### Можно ли upload любую song для теста?
Нет. Используйте audio, которое вы имеете право upload и process, и сохраняйте source и permission notes до test.
### Результат автоматически готов для commercial use?
Нет. Проверьте tool terms, source-audio rights, platform requirements и client approval перед публикацией.

zh.title: 给 vocal recording 加 instrumental，不要把 singer 埋掉

body: 你有一段带 melody 的短 recording：可能是手机里的 hook、song idea，或者你有权使用的 session vocal stem。问题通常从让 AI 在它周围加一整支 band 开始。结果可能更大，但也可能盖住 words，改变 emotional center，或者让 singer 被困在一个没有 clear job 的 arrangement 里。
## EasyMusic.AI 是什么？

Useful source 不必是 perfect studio vocal，但应该有 clear melody 和 intentional phrasing。选择一个 singer、room noise 较少、words 或 humming 不靠猜也能辨认的 section。如果 file 主要是 spoken explanation、包含多个人声互相竞争，或每个 bar 的 tempo 都在漂，system 可能会把它当作 general idea，而不是需要 accompaniment 的 vocal。写一条短 note：谁录的，为什么你有权使用，要 test 哪个 section。
## Prompt 前先画 accompaniment map

选择一个有 musical start 和 end 的短 range：complete phrase、chorus hook，或 one verse line。不要在 word 中间切，也不要在 phrase resolve 前停。用一个小 map 写出 backing role：support the melody、add pulse for demo、keep the vocal intimate，或 make the chorus feel wider。然后写出不能发生的事：no busy lead guitar over words、no huge drums、no key change、no choir covering the singer。这些 boundaries 会保护 existing voice。
## Style brief 要小

请求一个坐在 vocal 周围、不是压在它上面的 arrangement。一个有用 prompt 可以是：soft acoustic guitar and brushed drums, 82 BPM feel, leave space around every line, warm bass only after the first phrase, no lead vocal, no dramatic build。每次 test 只改一个 instrument 或 texture：用 piano 替代 guitar，用 light percussion 替代 drums，或用 warmer bass 替代 brighter synth。如果同时改 genre、tempo 和 density，你就不知道哪一版为什么有效。

## 今天就能复用的 ideas

- 先 test eight bars，再处理 whole recording。
- Upload 前，在 source file 旁边写 permission note。
- 从 one lead instrument 和 one support rhythm 开始，不要先要 full band。
- 当 lyrics 或 pronunciation 重要时，请求 space around words。
- 比较 piano、guitar、synth versions 时，保持同一个 source range。
- 把 original vocal、generated version、review notes 和 final choice 放在一个 folder。

## FAQ
### 需要 perfect vocal recording 吗？
不需要，但 source 要清楚到可以判断。Steady melody 和 low noise 比 expensive microphone 更重要。
### 我的 voice 会完全保持不变吗？
不一定。有些 workflows 会围绕 source 创建 new audio，也可能重新解释 timing 或 tone。一定要和 original 比较。
### Backing 盖住 words 怎么办？
减少 instruments，缩短 range，或请求 softer rhythm。问题通常是 density，不只是 volume。
### 可以 upload 任何 song 来试吗？
不可以。只使用你有权 upload 和 process 的 audio，并在 test 前保留 source 和 permission notes。
### 结果会自动适合 commercial use 吗？
不会。发布前请检查 tool terms、source-audio rights、platform requirements 和 client approval。
